copy.companyAbout:
PandaCodeGen designs and builds custom business websites, online stores and software. We work with owners and marketing teams launching a first site, improving an existing one or connecting the systems behind their business.

Website and simple-store builds start at US$1,500, with scope and fixed price agreed before work starts. You work directly with co-founders Hassan Jamal and Imran Raza Ladhani. Website builds include an editor for the agreed content, training and code you own.

Our work includes:
- New websites, redesigns and migrations, with URLs, content and integrations planned when an existing site needs to move.
- Online stores with product, ordering and payment workflows scoped around the business.
- Custom software, CRMs, dashboards and integrations, quoted for the work required.
- Optional monthly AI SEO services from US$500, with coverage, deliverables and the monthly fee agreed before we begin.

Where needed, we also scope Meta Conversions API implementation and lead attribution as part of the project. What can be recorded depends on the platform, access and available source data.

We build with Next.js and use Sanity where the project needs it. Hosting and ongoing support are agreed separately. Search rankings, AI citations and sales are outcomes we measure, not guarantees.

See our work: https://www.pandacodegen.com/work
Talk directly with the founders: https://www.pandacodegen.com/contact
copy.technicalBio: We build websites, stores and business software with Next.js, TypeScript and Sanity where needed. We share implementation notes from client work and clearly labelled founder-affiliated projects.
